user_query: trass gmail that mentions shipBob or merchant

intent.goal: find gmail messages related to ShipBob or merchant

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipBob%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant%'
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.sender_name LIKE '%merchant%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.sender_email LIKE '%merchant%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
